summary: News Corp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) regarding its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program, disclosing daily ASX transaction information. The program authorizes the company to acquire Class A and Class B common stock from time to time, with no specific price/share, premium, or close date stated. The board has previously authorized the program; no advisor is named. This is a routine buyback disclosure under ASX rules, similar to a US issuer's periodic share repurchase update. Watch for ongoing repurchase activity level and impact on shares outstanding.
